//: Static hosting of the rendered briefings, and nothing else. docs/ is what
build_preview.py writes and what GitHub Pages already serves, so Vercel is
pointed at the same folder rather than at a second copy of it.
No build step: these are finished HTML files. Nothing here runs the
pipeline, reads the history store, or needs a credential - a run takes
hours and belongs on the local runner, not in a serverless request.
The read-only viewer lives in viewer/index.py, deliberately OUTSIDE api/ so
that Vercel does not pick it up as a function. To turn it on: move it back
to api/index.py, add a rewrite of / to /api/index below, and set
DATABASE_URL in the project's environment settings.
